parsed.summary: Tracing every net shows the build matches the specification functionally: SS54/PMEG3030EP diodes, the IRLML6402 high-side battery switch with 47k gate resistor and SPDT, the BC857 auto-direction driver into the MAX3485 (DE/RE tied, 20k pull-down, 10k/5.1k TXD2 divider), the 2k/2.2k/2.2k A-B fail-safe bias, four 100 µF servo-rail caps plus a 0.1 µF 3V3 decoupler, four 0 Ω PWM-pin-select jumpers and two 0 Ω serial jumpers, and the 1 kΩ series signal resistors are all present with the correct values and connections. The reference designators are wholesale renumbered relative to the spec (e.g. J1/J2→J1/J7, D1/D2→D2/D3, U1→U2, R9–R14→R10/R22/R3/R8/R7/R12) and the blue 'Short R13, R14…' / 'Short R10, R10…' notes still cite the old numbers; both are naming/annotation (ordering) differences, not behavioral deviations, so no anomaly is reported.
